name: gallery-shell
description: The Photo Gallery's page shell: the still-frame top bar, the album rail with counts and storage, the shared page pieces (head, tabs, masonry grid, pager) and the lightbox keys.
mount: a row `- id: gallery-shell` / `name: gallery-shell` after the gallery row and before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects `shell`

config.prefix: the mount prefix the frame host chose; set by createApp, not by hand
